actions.action: Check soil surface and pot rim for white mineral crust
Move plant out of direct sun to bright indirect light
Alternatively hang a sheer curtain between plant and glass
Check soil moisture with a finger before watering
Water thoroughly when top 2-3 cm is dry
Empty the saucer within 30 minutes of watering
Use filtered or rainwater, or let tap water sit overnight
Flush soil by watering heavily every few months
Trim brown leaf tips with clean scissors
Check base/center for mushiness or loose dead leaves
If crown is rotting, remove rotten parts and reduce watering
Check whether roots are circling the pot
If rootbound, repot into fresh mix in slightly larger pot

reason: The answer diagnoses sun scorch and advises moving the plant out of direct sun, the opposite of the confirmed too-little-light problem fixed by giving more light outdoors, so cutting its light would make it worse.
